display_name: Sheets Spreadsheets Get By Data Filter
description: sheets.spreadsheets.getByDataFilter: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:getByDataFilter. Returns the spreadsheet at the given ID. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID. For more information, see Read, write, and search metadata. This method differs from GetSpreadsheet in that it allows selecting which subsets of spreadsheet data to return by specifying a dataFilters parameter. Multiple DataFilters can be specified. Specifying one or more data filters returns the portions of the spreadsheet that intersect ranges matched by any of the filters. By default, data within grids is not returned. Body: vendor GetSpreadsheetByDataFilterRequest JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Get By Data Filter to returns the spreadsheet at the given ID in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:getByDataFilter). Send the vendor GetSpreadsheetByDataFilterRequest body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.
